summary: Iteration-4 targeted regression on 4 reported items: Flash-Drop price/name visibility, Search-as-centered-modal, Mobile/Tablet quick-add-without-hover, Auth redesign + Google button + backend /api/auth/google/session endpoint. Backend: 4/4 new tests in test_google_auth.py PASS (missing session_id -> 400, empty -> 400, invalid -> 401, no user creation on failure). Frontend: search modal IS centered (off-center 0.00003px) with dark backdrop and closes on backdrop/X; mobile 390px shows product-card-mobile-add-* visible by default and clicking increments cart-toggle badge to '1'; login and register both render new split-card layout with google-login-btn visible; email/password admin login (sahilwaheed48@gmail.com/Admin@12345) redirects to /admin; Google button triggers navigation to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=...%2Faccount. TWO NEW BUGS FOUND (see frontend_issues).

ui_bugs.component: ProductCard (used inside Flash Drop grid in Home.jsx)
ui_bugs.issue: Product NAME (h3 with data-testid product-card-title-*) is WHITE on WHITE inside Flash Drop cards -> INVISIBLE. The user's original bug was 'white text on white card'; price + strikethrough were fixed, but the title still inherits color:white from the parent <section class='bg-obsidian text-white'> and the inner .bg-white card does not override h3 color. Computed style confirmed: title color = rgb(255,255,255) on card-bg rgb(255,255,255). Screenshot confirms only brand ('TERRACE CO' text-ink-400) + price + strikethrough are visible; the product name row is blank. Fix: give ProductCard's h3 an explicit dark color class (e.g. text-obsidian) or wrap the info block with text-obsidian, OR remove text-white from the Flash section and only apply to headings/labels that need it.

Requirement says 'On tablet/mobile, product cards must show the size/quick-add button BY DEFAULT'. Current class is `md:hidden` which hides the button at >=768px, so at 820px (iPad / tablet portrait) the Quick Add button is HIDDEN. Verified: at viewport 820x1180 -> 0/3 product-card-mobile-add-* visible; at 767px -> 3/3 visible; at 390px -> 5/5 visible and add-to-cart increments cart count to 1. Fix: change `md:hidden` to `lg:hidden` on line 148 so the mobile-add button shows on all non-desktop viewports (touch devices <1024px). The desktop hover overlay uses `hidden md:block` on line 100 — that also needs to become `hidden lg:block` to keep them mutually exclusive.

action_items: ProductCard.jsx: force product-card-title-* to a dark color (e.g. add `text-obsidian` to the h3 or to the info wrapper div) so the name is readable inside the Flash Drop section which sets text-white on the parent.

ProductCard.jsx: change breakpoint on lines 100 & 148 from `md:` to `lg:` so the always-visible Quick Add button appears on tablets (768–1023px), not just mobile <768px. Then re-verify at 820px and 1024px.
No backend action needed — /api/auth/google/session correctly returns 400 for missing and 401 for invalid session_id, and does not create a user on failure.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard.jsx duplicates the handleAdd invocation in two places (hover overlay button + mobile persistent button) — refactor is optional but the styling divergence is exactly what caused the tablet-hidden bug.

Home.jsx Flash Drop section applies `text-white` at section level and then wraps each card in `bg-white p-2` — this white-on-white anti-pattern will re-appear for any future text added inside the card unless the card wrapper explicitly resets `text-obsidian`.
Auth.jsx googleLogin: hard-codes the /account redirect path — fine, but users landing here from /admin login intent will not land on /admin. Acceptable per spec but worth documenting.
server.py /auth/google/session uses synchronous `requests.get` inside an async endpoint — will block the event loop under load; consider httpx.AsyncClient.
server.py is ~1336 lines — still worth splitting (flagged in iter-2/3).

success_rate.frontend: 5/7 checks pass (search-modal, mobile-quick-add-visible+functional, auth-redesign, google-btn+redirect, admin-login-redirect). 2 fail: flash-drop-title invisible; tablet-quick-add hidden at 820px.

seed_data_creation: None. Only added one item to guest cart during mobile quick-add smoke test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs are single-line CSS fixes in /app/frontend/src/components/ProductCard.jsx. After E1 fixes: (1) re-verify Flash Drop card at desktop 1920px — title 'Dunk Low Coastline Blue' should be visible in dark color; (2) re-verify mobile-add button visible at viewports 390, 767, 820, 1023 and HIDDEN at 1024+. Backend google-auth tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py — run `pytest backend/tests/test_google_auth.py -v`.
rca of the issue: Flash-title invisible: Home.jsx section <section className='bg-obsidian text-white ...'> sets color:white on all descendants; ProductCard info block does not re-declare a dark color for its h3, so on white card background the title inherits white. Only the price gets a color because it has font-mono class combined with `text-obsidian` (via `font-bold text-obsidian`), but the h3 title has no explicit color -> inherits white. Tablet quick-add hidden: Tailwind's `md:` breakpoint = 768px. The `md:hidden` on the mobile-only Quick Add hides it at 768px+, but iPads/tablets are typically 768–1024px. Requirement was 'touch devices' which include tablets, so breakpoint must be `lg:` (1024px).
